steps.title: Problem first
steps.body: Every project starts with a question: what decision is the user making here? Nothing gets built until that answer is clear.

steps.title: Then the system
steps.body: Screens are built as a system, not one at a time — type, spacing and motion follow the same rules. Every feature added later costs less because of it.

principles.title: Product thinking
principles.body: Before writing code, I define the problem, the user and what the product is for. I built this approach working on iOS and fintech products.

principles.title: Agent orchestration
principles.body: I don't work with a single agent but with several in parallel, and I orchestrate them. I approve serious changes and decisions only after reviewing them myself.

principles.title: A working product
principles.body: My goal is to turn an idea into a working, useful product faster.
